map.→ 打开加盟（标准/支持/评估）体系工具: -> Open the franchise (standard / support / evaluation) system tool
map.准备加盟某酒店品牌前，用 5 维度（品牌标准/总部支持/会员体系/供应链/盈利能: Before joining a hotel brand, score five dimensions item by item - brand standards, head office support, membership system, supply chain and profitability - to judge quickly whether the system is mature and which link is weakest.
map.加盟后年度复盘：按同 5 维度复评，跟踪总部承诺的「支持/供应链」是否落地，作为: Annual review after joining a franchise: re-score the same five dimensions, track whether the support and supply chain the head office promised actually materialised, and use it as the basis for renewing or exiting.
map.单体酒店能用吗？: Can an independent hotel use it?
map.各维度权重一样吗？: Are the weights of the dimensions the same?
map.对比 2-3 个候选品牌时，按相同维度与分值逐项打分后横向排序，优先选总分高且短: When comparing 2-3 candidate brands, score the same dimensions with the same scale item by item, then rank them side by side and prefer a high total score whose weaknesses can be fixed, so a single highlight does not mislead you.
map.本工具默认等权（每项 1-5 分、总分 5-25、百分制=总分/25×100）。: This tool weights dimensions equally by default (each 1-5, total 5-25, percentage score = total / 25 x 100). In real decisions brand standards and profitability are usually more critical and can be weighted subjectively in the notes, but equal weighting is already enough for side-by-side comparison.
map.能。维度针对「加盟体系」设计，单体自营店无总部支持/会员体系可填「缺失(1分)」: Yes. The dimensions are designed for a franchise system, so an independent store with no head office support or membership system can enter "missing (1 point)" and ignore the corresponding items; it is only an internal standardisation self-check.
map.酒店加盟（标准/支持/评估）体系工具。从 5 个维度（每项 1–5 分）量化评估: Hotel franchise (standard / support / evaluation) system tool. Quantifies the standards, support and implementation of a franchise system across 5 dimensions (each 1-5), totals the scores and gives optimisation advice for hotel franchise decisions.
map.：5 维均选「较好(4分)」→ 总分=4×5=20，百分制=20/25×100=: : all five dimensions set to "fairly good (4 points)" gives a total of 4 x 5 = 20, a percentage score of 20 / 25 x 100 = 80. Breaking it down: brand standards 4, head office support 4, membership system 4, supply chain 3 (no advantage in purchase price) and profitability 4. Conclusion: the system is fairly mature, the only weakness is the supply chain, so press purchase costs in negotiation; if the supply chain reaches 4 the total becomes 21, or 84.
